## Decision
Adopt the Enrichment & Validation chapter in **Selection Violet** as the second homepage use-case world.
## Approved characteristics
- Company Name Match is the selected proof using the deterministic `Spotify AB` / `Spotify Aktiebolag` known-answer fixture.
- Email Validation and Phone Validate remain visibly separate next calls.
- A name match is not presented as legal-identity proof or contact-data validation.
- Generated imagery contains no UI, values, text, logos or product claims.
- Desktop and mobile preserve the same truth hierarchy without swipe-only interaction.
## Relationship
This extends `DEC-20260820-C-WEBSITE-COMPANY-RESEARCH` and its Separate Lenses grammar.
## Boundary
This decision approves the design direction only. It does not authorize website implementation or any outward release.
